name: pending-removals-read-untested
body: The ledger read has no test of its own: `pending_removals` is a one-projection `MATCH (n:PendingRemoval) RETURN n.fqn ORDER BY n.fqn`, and its first real exercise is the phase-1 task-10 e2e over record-then-read (the table and its reader are otherwise unpinned). Upgrade — give the read its own case — if the query grows a filter, a limit, or a second column, since the record-then-read e2e asserts only the identities it recorded.
